rafa: Heads up  small steady delta where requests with header `X-Client-API: v2; v1` are landing on v1. Seen across two routes. noticed in per-route traces.

neha: semicolon? our parser only split on commas historically. which SDK is emitting that?

rafa: looks like an older in-house proxy that joins tokens with `;` when chaining. staging had a tiny signal but prod is ~0.9% for those routes.

derek: current behavior: parser returns a multi-token array and we pick the last token (legacy code). dangerous because older tokens win. we should prefer the most recent/stable supported version instead.

neha: agree. proposal: defensive routing + quarantine. If header splits to >1 token or contains unknown tokens -> mark `ambiguous_version=true`, route to preferred/latest supported (v2) as shadow, and set `quota_exempt=true` until we verify.

lucy: console ask: add a short-lived card on the route detail page "Ambiguous API headers" with top client ids and raw header examples. owners should get a soft alert if cohort >0.5% for 10m.

derek: quick JS sketch for parse change: ```js
const raw = req.headers['x-client-api'] || '';
const tokens = raw.split(/[;,\s]+/).filter(Boolean);
if (tokens.length === 0) return defaultRoute();
const prefer = ['v2','v1'];
const chosen = prefer.find(p => tokens.includes(p)) || tokens[0];
routeTo(chosen);
```

rafa: telemetry: emit `version_header_raw`, `version_tokens` (sampled), and `routing_decision` values `preferred_pick`, `ambiguous_quarantine`, `no_header`. Keep 100% for quarantine cohort, 0.5% sampling for other anomalies.

infra-bot: Created INF-2501 to track: parser change, quota-exempt path, console card, SDK proxy outreach.

neha: rollout cadence: flag `header-ambig-protect` -> enable 1% for 20m, check token-cost, error-rate, latency, then 10% 1h, then 100%. Rollback if token-cost per req increases >0.8% or if 5xx spikes +0.2%.

console-bot: Alert rule `ambiguous_header_cohort` added. Will post into #eng-platform-incidents when >0.5% sustained for 10m.

lucy: important: ensure quota service recognizes `quota_exempt=true`. Otherwise customers could see 429s when we intended quarantine to be non-billing.

derek: will add header `x-quarantine: ambiguous-version` in the proxy path so quota layer can detect easily.

rafa: I'll own the PR and the runbook: if cohort >1% and top clients are internal -> tag infra on INF-2501 and ask for release. If external client dominates, reach out via account team.

infra-bot: INF-2501 updated with a short list of candidate proxies (proxy-a, proxy-b) that historically mutate headers.

neha: thanks. scheduling a 30m post-rollout check for tomorrow after 100% flip.

rafa: cool. keeping this thread as canonical. I'll paste PR and dashboard links when ready. :rocket:
